beaches.name: Glass Beach, California
beaches.description: A rugged stretch of Northern California coast where decades of sea-tumbled glass glitter across the sand like scattered gemstones.

beaches.name: Navagio Beach, Greece
beaches.description: A hidden cove on Zakynthos island, reachable only by boat, framed by white limestone cliffs and turquoise Ionian water.

beaches.name: Whitehaven Beach, Australia
beaches.description: Seven kilometers of pure silica sand in the Whitsunday Islands, so fine it stays cool underfoot even at midday.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: The world's largest religious monument, its five lotus-bud towers rising over jungle at sunrise in a scene few forget.

temples.name: Kinkaku-ji, Japan
temples.description: Kyoto's Golden Pavilion, its top two floors covered in gold leaf, mirrored perfectly in the still pond below.

temples.name: Prambanan, Indonesia
temples.description: A ninth-century Hindu temple compound near Yogyakarta, its spires the tallest Hindu structures in Southeast Asia.

cities.name: Kyoto
cities.description: Wooden temples, bamboo groves, and quiet lantern-lit streets in Japan's former imperial capital.

cities.name: Tokyo
cities.description: Neon crossings, centuries-old shrines, and some of the world's best food, all within a single subway map.

cities.name: Rome
cities.description: Two thousand years of history stacked on top of itself, from the Colosseum to sunlit piazzas and espresso bars.

cities.name: Venice
cities.description: A city built on water, where gondolas glide past faded palazzos and every turn reveals another quiet canal.

cities.name: Cusco
cities.description: The former Incan capital, cobblestone streets built on ancient stone foundations, gateway to Machu Picchu.

cities.name: Lima
cities.description: A coastal capital known for cliffside parks, colonial architecture, and some of South America's finest cooking.
